messages:
ernest: Heads-up — opened PR https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/789 to add the Private Deployment migration guide. It includes an SDK example that accidentally shows an internal customer identifier. Asking for security/legal quick review before merge. @sarah @matt

sarah: Thanks for flagging. Can you paste the exact snippet here and the docs preview link? I'll triage. :eyes:

ernest: Preview is here: https://deploy-preview-789--docs.redwood.ai. CI shows the preview but the checklist bot marked sensitive-content. Snippet:```yaml
# example config
customer_id: "acct-1234-RED"
private_endpoint: "https://private.redwood.example"
```
We should redact the customer_id and replace with a placeholder (e.g. <CUSTOMER_ID>) and note in the text that the example is anonymized.

matt: From legal — exposing customer identifiers in public docs is a no-go. Redact and add a note: "Example values are fictional and anonymized." I'll sign off after that change.

lucy: This is blocking the enterprise customer onboarding timeline — they asked for the migration guide in their runbook this week. If we can merge after redaction and a quick security thumbs-up, we can ship.

sarah: Quick plan: 1) redact customer_id in the PR, 2) push an amended markdown commit, 3) I will run a short review (10-15m) and mark approval. Also want to audit the rest of the file for any other identifiers.

ernest: I pushed a commit that replaces the value with `<REDACTED>` and added the anonymized note. See diff: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/789/files

ci-bot: docs-preview: build passed for PR #789 — preview URL: https://deploy-preview-789--docs.redwood.ai ✅

ci-bot: however, static-scan:found: potential secret in examples (customer_id pattern). Marked as manual review required.

sarah: I'll check the file now. If the commit removes real IDs and adds the note, I'm fine signing off. One request: switch the example to use `ACME_CORP_EXAMPLE_ID` rather than `<REDACTED>` so readers understand it's a placeholder.

ernest: Updated to `ACME_CORP_EXAMPLE_ID` and added the sentence: "All example identifiers are fictional and redacted for privacy." Pushed.

matt: LGTM from legal. Please include a short changelog entry in the PR description noting the redaction for compliance audit.

sarah: Security approved. No other identifiers found in the file. I'm adding a reaction :white_check_mark:.

lucy: Awesome — can we merge this after CI completes? We need to publish for the customer call on Friday.

ernest: CI currently green, docs preview updated. Who should merge? I can merge but want to wait until everyone confirms.

matt: Go ahead and merge after the changelog note is added. I'm good with post-merge audit logs retained.

ernest: Changelog note added to PR description: "Redacted example customer identifier; legal & security approved (matt, sarah)." Merging in 5 — will notify release channel.

devex-bot: PR #789 merged by ernest. Deployed to staging docs. Publish scheduled for 2026-03-27 10:00 UTC.

lucy: Thanks team. Please add the migration guide link to the customer runbook once published.

ernest: Will do. Thanks all!"
